slots.name: Electrocute
slots.short: Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities in 3s deals bonus adaptive damage.

slots.name: Dark Harvest
slots.short: Damaging a low health champion inflicts <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'>adaptive damage</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> and harvests a soul from the victim.

slots.name: Hail of Blades
slots.short: Gain a large amount of Attack Speed and <trueDamage>bonus true damage</trueDamage> for the first 3 attacks made against enemy champions.

slots.name: Cheap Shot
slots.short: Deal bonus true damage to enemy champions with <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_ImpairAct'>impaired movement or actions</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>.

slots.name: Taste of Blood
slots.short: Heal when you damage an enemy champion.

slots.name: Sudden Impact
slots.short: Damaging basic attacks and abilities deal bonus true damage to enemy champions after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when leaving stealth.

slots.name: Sixth Sense
slots.short:
On a long Cooldown, automatically sense a nearby untracked and unseen ward, tracking it for the team.

Level 11: Also reveal the ward for 10s.

slots.name: Grisly Mementos
slots.short:
Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns, up to 18 total.

Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected.

slots.name: Deep Ward
slots.short:
Your wards in the enemy jungle are Deep, gaining Health and Duration.

Level 9: Wards in the river are also Deep.

slots.name: Treasure Hunter
slots.short: Unique takedowns grant additional gold the first time they are collected.

slots.name: Relentless Hunter
slots.short: Unique takedowns grant permanent out of combat MS.

slots.name: Ultimate Hunter
slots.short: Unique takedowns grant permanent cooldown reduction on your Ultimate.

slots.name: Glacial Augment
slots.short: Immobilizing an enemy champion will cause 3 glacial rays that slow nearby enemies and reduce their damage to your allies.

slots.name: Unsealed Spellbook
slots.short: Swap Summoner Spells while out of combat. Swapping to unique Summoner Spells will increase the rate at which you can make future swaps.

slots.name: First Strike
slots.short: When you initiate champion combat, deal 7% extra damage for 3 seconds and gain gold based on damage dealt.

slots.name: Hextech Flashtraption
slots.short:
While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash.

Hexflash: Channel, then blink to a new location.

slots.name: Magical Footwear
slots.short: You get free boots at 12 min but you cannot buy boots before then. Each <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Takedown'>takedown</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> you get makes your boots come 45s sooner.

slots.name: Cash Back
slots.short: Get some gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.

slots.name: Triple Tonic
slots.short:
Upon reaching level 3, gain an Elixir of Avarice.
Upon reaching level 6, gain an Elixir of Force.
Upon reaching level 9, gain an Elixir of Skill.

slots.name: Time Warp Tonic
slots.short: Potions grant some restoration immediately.

slots.name: Biscuit Delivery
slots.short: Gain a free Biscuit every 2 min, until 6 min. Consuming or selling a Biscuit permanently increases your max health and restores health.

slots.name: Cosmic Insight
slots.short:
+18 Summoner Spell Haste
+10 Item Haste

slots.name: Approach Velocity
slots.short: Bonus <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> towards nearby enemy champions that are <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_ImpairMov'>movement impaired</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>, increased for enemy champions that you impair.

slots.name: Jack Of All Trades
slots.short:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks.

slots.name: Press the Attack
slots.short: Hitting an enemy champion 3 consecutive times deals bonus damage and amplifies your damage until you leave combat with champions.

slots.name: Lethal Tempo
slots.short: Attacking an enemy champion grants you Attack Speed, up to 6 stacks. At max stacks, deal <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'><font color='#48C4B7'>bonus adaptive damage</font></lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> On-Attack.

slots.name: Fleet Footwork
slots.short: Attacking and moving builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack heals you and grants increased <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>.

slots.name: Conqueror
slots.short: Gain stacks of adaptive force when attacking enemy champions. After reaching 12 stacks, heal for a portion of damage you deal to champions.

slots.name: Absorb Life
slots.short: Killing a target heals you.

slots.name: Triumph
slots.short: <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Takedown'>Takedowns</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> restore 5% of your missing health and grant an additional 20 gold.

slots.name: Presence of Mind
slots.short: Restore a small amount of mana or energy when damaging an enemy champion. Takedowns restore mana or energy.

slots.name: Legend: Alacrity
slots.short: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Attack Speed.

slots.name: Legend: Haste
slots.short: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Basic Ability Haste.

slots.name: Legend: Bloodline
slots.short: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Life Steal, up to a cap. Once the cap is reached, increase your max health. Weaker earlier but stronger later game than other Legend Runes.

slots.name: Coup de Grace
slots.short: Deal more damage to low health enemy champions.

slots.name: Cut Down
slots.short: Deal more damage to high health enemy champions.

slots.name: Last Stand
slots.short: Deal more damage to champions while you are low on health.

slots.name: Grasp of the Undying
slots.short: Every 4s your next attack on a champion deals bonus magic damage, heals you, and permanently increases your health.

slots.name: Aftershock
slots.short: After <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Immobilize'>immobilizing</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> an enemy champion gain defenses and later deal a burst of magic damage around you.

slots.name: Guardian
slots.short: Guard allies you cast spells on and those that are very nearby. If you or a guarded ally would take damage based on level, you're both granted a shield.

slots.name: Demolish
slots.short: Your third attack against turrets deals bonus damage.

slots.name: Font of Life
slots.short: <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_ImpairMov'>Impairing</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> the movement of an enemy champion heals nearby allied champions.

slots.name: Shield Bash
slots.short: Whenever you gain a shield, your next basic attack against a champion deals bonus <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'><font color='#48C4B7'>adaptive</font></lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> damage.

slots.name: Conditioning
slots.short: After 12 min gain +8 Armor and +8 Magic Resist and increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 3%.

slots.name: Second Wind
slots.short: After taking damage from an enemy champion heal back some missing health over time.

slots.name: Bone Plating
slots.short:
After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 spells or attacks you receive from them deal 30-60 (based on level) less damage.

Duration: 1.5s
Cooldown: 55s

slots.name: Overgrowth
slots.short: Gain permanent max health when minions or monsters die near you.

slots.name: Revitalize
slots.short:
Gain 5% Heal and Shield Power.

Heals and shields you cast or receive are 10% stronger on targets below 40% health.

slots.name: Unflinching
slots.short: Gain Armor and Magic Resist when receiving crowd control.

slots.name: Summon Aery
slots.short: Your attacks and abilities send Aery to a target, damaging enemies or shielding allies.

slots.name: Arcane Comet
slots.short: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a damaging comet at their location.

slots.name: Stormraider's Surge
slots.short: Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum health grants a burst of <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> and Slow Resist.

slots.name: Deathfire Touch
slots.short: Damaging a champion with an ability burns them over time.

slots.name: Axiom Arcanist
slots.short: Your Ultimate has increased damage, healing, and shielding. Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your Ultimate's current cooldown.

slots.name: Manaflow Band
slots.short:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your maximum mana by 25, up to 250 mana.

After reaching 250 bonus mana, restore 1% of your missing mana every 5 seconds.

slots.name: Nimbus Cloak
slots.short: After casting a Summoner Spell, gain a short <speed>Move Speed</speed> increase that allows you to pass through units.

slots.name: Transcendence
slots.short:
Gain bonuses upon reaching the following levels:
Level 5: +5 Ability Haste
Level 8: +5 Ability Haste
Level 11: On Champion takedown, reduce the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20%.

slots.name: Celerity
slots.short: All <speed>Move Speed</speed> bonuses are 7% more effective on you and gain <speed>1% Move Speed</speed>.

slots.name: Absolute Focus
slots.short: While above 70% health, gain extra <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'>adaptive damage</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>.

slots.name: Scorch
slots.short: Your first damaging ability hit every 10s burns champions.

slots.name: Waterwalking
slots.short: Gain <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> and AP or AD, <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'>adaptive</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> in the river.

slots.name: Gathering Storm
slots.short: Gain increasing amounts of AD or AP, <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'>adaptive</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> over the course of the game.
